items.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Is Exposed To Proposed US Chip Tariffs
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) is in focus as the U.S. government reportedly weighs new tariffs on semiconductors and related technology hardware. The potential measures target imported chips and components that could affect AMD's supply chain and manufacturing costs. Any tariff decision would add a fresh regulatory risk factor for AMD in addition to existing attention on AI and security issues. This possible shift in trade policy highlights the broader story around AI infrastructure...
